$description: Encave design tokens (W3C design tokens format). Single source of truth for Apple and Android. Run design/generate_apple_assets.py after editing.

studio-base.$description: Studio backdrop behind label photos and covers: warm cream, or warm near-black in dark mode

studio-candle.$description: Warm candle light of the out-of-focus discs on the studio backdrop

studio-red.$description: Wine color of the studio backdrop (wash and light discs); white wine as straw gold

launch-background.$description: Android launch window before the first frame (the brand scheme's background)

maturity-drink-soon.$description: Maturity symbols; always with a word, at least 4.5:1 on the background

warning.$description: Text and icons of a warning (at least 4.5:1 on the light and dark backgrounds); always next to an icon or words

success.$description: Text and icons of a success (at least 4.5:1 on the backgrounds); always next to an icon or words

error.$description: Text and icons of an error (at least 4.5:1 on the backgrounds); always next to an icon or words

action.$description: Fill of a secondary action (swipe actions), under white text and icons (at least 4.5:1)

destructive.$description: Fill of an action that takes a bottle out (swipe actions), under white text and icons

neutral.$description: Fill of a neutral action, or of a bottle whose wine has no style, under white text and icons

on-tint.$description: Small symbols on an accent or warning fill (badges, checkmarks)

ink-on-light.$description: Text on a light wine color, the same in both modes (the fill does not change)

ink-on-dark.$description: Text on a dark wine color, the same in both modes
